metadata.description: A background child session starts before its launch result names it, so T3 buffers its events. The child streams more than the 512-event buffer holds and ends a model step with stop inside its still-open execution, then its terminal is lost. When the launch result binds the child, the buffered prefix replays and the synthetic overflow failure settles the child; the stop step must not complete it. The parent turn still completes.

data.title: T3 OpenCode 2 deferred child overflow replay

prompt.text: Start one background subagent with description overflow child fixture and prompt Respond exactly CHILD_OVERFLOW_OK. Then respond exactly PARENT_AFTER_OVERFLOW without waiting for the child.
